jobs.title: Sr. 3D Generalist, UX
jobs.description_text: The Role We are looking for a Senior 3D Technical Artist & Motion Designer to join the Lucid UX/UI team and help define the next generation of digital vehicle experiences. This role sits at the intersection of 3D design, motion, real-time rendering, and product development. You will create high-quality vehicle visualizations, real-time 3D assets, animations, and motion experiences for customer-facing applications while ensuring that content performs efficiently within demanding embedded compute environments. You will work closely with UX/UI Designers, Vehicle Designers, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to establish both the visual quality and the production processes required to bring sophisticated 3D experiences into production. The ideal candidate combines a strong visual eye with deep technical fluency. You should be equally comfortable refining lighting and materials in a 3D scene, rigging and animating a vehicle, optimizing an asset for a constrained GPU target, collaborating with engineers on implementation, and using emerging AI tools to accelerate and improve the creative workflow. What You'll Do Real-Time 3D & Visualization Create high-quality real-time 3D vehicle models, renderings, environments, and visual experiences for customer-facing UX applications. jobs.title: Sr. Design Engineer, Wire Harness
jobs.description_text: The Resident Launch Engineer is the plant-based engineering organization responsible for resolving product issues that impact vehicles in production. This Sr. Engineering role will be supporting Low Voltage Harness, across Lucid’s launch and production vehicle programs. The role exists to strengthen engineering ownership for launch and production issue triage, containment, root cause analysis, permanent corrective actions and cross-functional escalation management. In the first 12 months, success means establishing clear issue ownership, improving response time to production concerns, reducing repeat issues, and creating a stronger feedback loop between current production, future programs and core Vehicle Engineering teams. What you will find here that you will not find in a comparable role elsewhere is direct influence over complete vehicle system robustness across structural, closure, mechanical and electrical interfaces in a fast-moving EV manufacturing environment. What You'll Own Senior Engineering: Support the VHE organization across LV Harness, while balancing workloads and building capabilities for current production, launch support, and continuous improvement. Product Issue Resolution: Own engineering triage for production and field concerns, ensuring clear problem definition, risk assessment, containment, root cause investigation, corrective action planning and effectiveness verification. jobs.title: Intern, LLM Inference Acceleration Architecture (Distributed Memory-Centric Accelerators)
jobs.description_text: What You’ll Learn Project Overview: In memory-centric AI accelerators, many memory devices each process data in place and only exchange small partial results, which are then merged. As LLM attention evolves from grouped-query attention (GQA) to multi-head latent attention (MLA) and sparse top-k attention, the work done locally on each device shrinks while cross-device merge and reduction increasingly dominate decode latency. Using the team’s in-house performance model and simulator, you will explore the design space of merge/reduction architectures — where reduction happens, how devices are connected, and at what precision partial results are exchanged — and propose an architecture that performs well across modern attention workloads. Skills You’ll Learn: Architecture-level performance modeling and design-space exploration for distributed, memory-centric AI accelerators How modern attention variants (GQA, MLA, sparse top-k attention) map onto distributed memory, and how they shift the balance between computation and communication Hardware–software co-design of interconnect and reduction (collective) hardware for LLM inference What You’ll Do The AGI team at Samsung Semiconductor explores memory-centric system architectures for next-generation AI inference, where computation happens close to where data lives. The Legal Assistant position includes substantial review of client and corporate vendor agreements, ad hoc legal research, drafting policies, and providing other legal-related support. What makes this position particularly exciting is the level of close cooperation with other members of the Legal Department and substantive interaction with the Firm’s domestic and international consulting and corporate services staff as well as external law firm personnel and client procurement departments. As the firm grows, this position offers increasing responsibility and challenging work to the right candidate.
